sectionHeading: STRESS-TEST CONNECTION ANSWERS — 31 TARGETED ANSWERS, CURRENT RECEIVING

answers.answer: bills-carry-no-policy-alternatives: register reusable proposition families in the existing loaded policy registry, with generated selected parameters/alternatives bound to actual provisions. Sourced issue vocabulary and authored simulated policy choices have different provenance. Current boundary checks loaded IDs: do not mint unadmitted per-bill definitions directly in a save. Preserve operative tax/budget provision meaning. One selected alternative drives text, evaluation and eventual effect; unselected options never execute.
answers.caveats: none

answers.answer: policy-effect-model-state-and-local: passage→effective rule→covered activity/base→actual tax/payment/service→scoped aggregate response. Keep the existing macro kernel. More tax revenue is not automatically a positive national GDP shock. An appropriation is not spending; a transfer is not newly produced output. Match geography, units, period and baseline; deduplicate origin/provision/revision/effect channels. Repeal does not erase spent money or built infrastructure. Existing0.05pp/0.01pp/0.6 placeholders are not confirmed. Exact funded execution can be delivered independently of those uncertain coefficients.
answers.caveats: "Existing0.05pp/0.01pp/0.6 placeholders are not confirmed."

answers.answer: what-should-the-world-do-to-a-person: event→known exposure→memory/appraisal→relevance to an actual proposition→existing belief evaluator. Retain no-opinion/defer/conflicted outcomes. Same hurricane can motivate different policy interpretations or no opinion. Public stance, promise and vote are separate. No auto-belief change for the controlled player, no magical knowledge, no new age cutoff or numeric response schedule.
answers.caveats: "No auto-belief change for the controlled player, no magical knowledge, no new age cutoff or numeric response schedule."

answers.answer: what-opens-a-scandal-about-somebody-else: the weekly rival-complaint path already exists. Broaden eligible actors and distinct incidents, not one-per-player-campaign or a scandal quota. Separate allegation/evidence/finding. Unfounded or deceptive allegations need a real claimant's mistake/intent; do not fabricate the accused person's crime. Matter deduplication follows incident/claim, not campaign lifetime. Rate and disposition percentages remain unselected.
answers.caveats: "Rate and disposition percentages remain unselected."

answers.answer: should-partisan-geography-move: yes, consistent with the owner's living world. Preserve startup conditions but let current opinion, participation, candidate alternatives and population composition develop. Aggregate regions from the same underlying quantities instead of applying a second swing bonus. Keep approval, belief, party affiliation and votes separate; no fixed points-per-year drift or guaranteed regional conversion.
answers.caveats: "no fixed points-per-year drift or guaranteed regional conversion."

answers.answer: how-does-a-party-get-on-a-ballot: party existence, membership, recognized nomination route, candidate filing and contest/date ballot status are distinct. Use saved applicable procedures and actual qualifying activity; incumbent parties' prior qualification comes from coherent generated history, not hardcoded names. Independent candidacy is separate. Recruitment must continue after founding. Exact state thresholds/dates remain factual inputs, not supplied by this paragraph; consume compatible existing approved profiles while that broader compilation is queued.
answers.caveats: "Exact state thresholds/dates remain factual inputs, not supplied by this paragraph; consume compatible existing approved profiles while that broader compilation is queued."

answers.answer: state-legislative-seat-calendar-and-field: real dates and multiple candidates/primaries/independents are already approved. A seeded2–4 field is not the completed model; eligible people, incumbency, party nomination, resources and goals should determine entries, including unopposed and crowded races. Persist the field; no re-rolling on refresh. Connect ordinary town to its state government independently of calendar research; candidacy is not years of compulsory daily campaigning.
answers.caveats: "A seeded2–4 field is not the completed model"

answers.answer: when-should-an-international-crisis-begin: international scope is already approved. A supported development with actual actors/interests/commitments and escalation state can feed the existing declaration route. The acting office governs decisions; other people learn public consequences. One persistent crisis, not a new event every weekly sweep. No arbitrary40-year quota; missing behavioral/rate content is distinct from wiring an existing usable origin.
answers.caveats: "No arbitrary40-year quota; missing behavioral/rate content is distinct from wiring an existing usable origin."

answers.answer: can-a-public-figure-be-attacked: severe events are already permitted possibilities; do not reopen that or remove the writer merely because it is rare. Keep canonical threat/intent prerequisites, abstract event consequences and lawful continuity. No random assassination timer or detailed violence instructions. Player-as-initiator control and exact frequencies remain separate unresolved matters, not inferred from background-event scope.
answers.caveats: "Player-as-initiator control and exact frequencies remain separate unresolved matters, not inferred from background-event scope."; "No random assassination timer or detailed violence instructions."

answers.answer: decision-thresholds-are-constants-in-code: classify integrity constraints, institutional rules, scheduling, model calibration and false row-count shortcuts. Moving an arbitrary counter toJSON does not fix it. Meaningful independent evidence, actual experience, organization governance and semantic episode roles replace two/three/ten-record shortcuts. threshold-dispositions.json covers11named cases. Earlier duplicate-party/commitment fixes are reported received; do not apply another reversal blindly.
answers.caveats: "Earlier duplicate-party/commitment fixes are reported received; do not apply another reversal blindly."

answers.answer: missing-fact-refuse-assert-rederive: derive known relationships; coherently materialize permitted missing game detail once; seek a genuinely required fact or block only that act; omit optional unavailable observations. Contradictions are not plausible fiction. Missing consent is not acceptance and unknown duration is not zero. Approved simulated rule profiles remain valid despite incomplete real-law surveys.
answers.caveats: "Approved simulated rule profiles remain valid despite incomplete real-law surveys."

answers.answer: mod-api-vocabulary-is-two-fields: broad supported content/rule extensions and explicit override, not prose-only mods. Skip/report the smallest coherent invalid independent item. A choice's cost/benefit/preconditions remain one validated transaction: never discard an unsupported cost while granting its reward. No raw host/save access. Actual runtime loader→effect→visible reader→Save/Continue is the proof, not a compile-time pack type.
answers.caveats: "Actual runtime loader→effect→visible reader→Save/Continue is the proof, not a compile-time pack type."

answers.answer: household-paper-surface-contents: show actual delivered correspondence/objects appropriate to the recipient and channel; a phone call is not automatically paper. Same offer/request identity across table/phone/person/job. Reading is not signing, paying or accepting. No fabricated bills, private rival dossiers or universal daily mail chores.
answers.caveats: none

answers.answer: finished-rooms-waiting-on-a-location: scheduled event→responsible body/committee→real or approved generated venue→room instance→compatible artwork. Floor/committee may share building but not room; player hometown is not every institution's venue. One generic plate can represent distinct rooms without collapsing their location identity. Travel/attendance are separate transitions.
answers.caveats: none

answers.answer: room-objects-beyond-the-first-three: communications and genuine role-related task/material surfaces next, not every decorative object made into a menu. Consistent pointer/keyboard affordance; no hover-side effects. Full-screen workspaces must not display a room television headline as a global banner. Source actual actions before adding labels.
answers.caveats: "Source actual actions before adding labels."

answers.answer: built-producers-with-no-player-entry: prioritize town→legislative context, offer/contact response, bills→operative effects; then public-matter/office-response/economic/constitutional entry. Normal actor/place/office routes, not a demo fixture wrapped as a menu. Correct emptiness is distinct from an uncalled producer or unusable join.
answers.caveats: "Correct emptiness is distinct from an uncalled producer or unusable join."

answers.answer: legislative-caucus-and-coalition-formation: formal caucus, issue coalition, committee membership and a one-bill agreement are distinct. A cross-party agreement need not change party affiliation. Record real interests/conditions/commitments and revisit affected commitments after amendment. No fixed agreeable-reply count creates a faction; no new frequency study required for the basic connection.
answers.caveats: "no new frequency study required for the basic connection."

answers.answer: party-body-dispute-cadence: stakes, unresolved meaningful disagreements, voice, attachments and feasible alternatives matter—not two defeats. Reviews permit decisions rather than require a split. Preserve actual positive evolution paths and test controls; zero in one save is not proof the engine never runs.
answers.caveats: "zero in one save is not proof the engine never runs."

answers.answer: scene-depth-ordering: same ground plane, back-to-front ground-contactY, stable ID tie-break; explicit backdrop/foreground bands and plane distinctions. Sort neither heads nor alpha centroids. Seated root belongs to the chair's ground reference, not whichever foot projects forward. Split long furniture/occluders when a person belongs partly behind and in front. Draw order and hit testing remain separately correct. Existing renderer, not a new engine.
answers.caveats: "Existing renderer, not a new engine."

answers.answer: apparent-turn-versus-silhouette-turn: centroid/outline asymmetry alone cannot establish facing. Translation or leaning changes it without rotating the body. Use declared pose plus actual head/shoulder/hip/depth cues and the target-chair composition. No invented perceptual confidence number or asset approval.
answers.caveats: "No invented perceptual confidence number or asset approval."

answers.answer: seated-figure-reads-as-in-the-seat: coordinate seat/pelvis contact, body scale, facing, thighs/feet and chair occlusion using the current compatible modular pose. No stretched standing pose. Publish the existing stranded3/4pose request via the real art intake; file-on-branch is not delivered. Keep functioning interaction available while art is resolved.
answers.caveats: "Publish the existing stranded3/4pose request via the real art intake; file-on-branch is not delivered."

answers.answer: person-with-no-artwork-on-screen: retain true identity/role/actions and a neutral clearly non-specific placeholder; never show another or retired person as this character. Expose diagnostic cause without flooding ordinary play with hashes. Latest supplied report corrected one supposed silent fallback to an explicit missing-input case; do not repeat its earlier diagnosis.
answers.caveats: "Latest supplied report corrected one supposed silent fallback to an explicit missing-input case; do not repeat its earlier diagnosis."

answers.answer: facial-expression-derivation: situational appraisal and intended presentation, not a permanent trait grimace or a lie detector. Same person, current supported cues, no extra emotion event from redraw. Exact new artwork remains owner acceptance.
answers.caveats: "Exact new artwork remains owner acceptance."

answers.answer: divergence-metrics-and-what-to-test / what-should-we-be-testing: keep the already-acknowledged six groups; add eligible→considered→initiated→communicated→reachable→committed→applied→observed counts. Distinguish absent opportunity, unknown data, invalid authority, broken producer and invisible result. Match cohorts, exposure, time, geography and real setup.seed; use controlled positive fixtures separately from ordinary play. Do not force all rare event counts positive.
answers.caveats: "Do not force all rare event counts positive."

answers.answer: SCENARIO/HISTORY: supplied larger sample reports age40reach-outs16/20old versus8/20new, mostly former colleagues, not a teacher every save. Preserve history/people and bind cause, actor role, target, knowledge, channel, terms and continuation to one episode ID. Scenario inventory/log is a projection of current definitions and actual instances. Word variants change expression, not number of incidents or chances to agree. The controlled player must never be auto-answered by the NPC routine.
answers.caveats: "Scenario inventory/log is a projection of current definitions and actual instances."; "The controlled player must never be auto-answered by the NPC routine."

answers.answer: COLLEGE→FRIEND→STAFF: maintain the same acquaintance across school, moves and later recruitment. Actual skills, role requirements, availability, terms and consent still matter; friendship enables opportunity, not guaranteed hiring or qualifications. Keep education compact. The unspecified 'cheating' example needs its intended meaning before that content is added, without holding the unrelated relationship chain.
answers.caveats: "The unspecified 'cheating' example needs its intended meaning before that content is added, without holding the unrelated relationship chain."

answers.answer: CATALOG BOUNDARY: reject undeclared fixtures and malformed content, not all approved authored simulation consequences. Extend declared metric/mechanism admission intentionally with reference/unit/provenance checks; no blanket assertWorldIntegrity removal. Generic catalog emptiness does not erase direct macro/crisis/life effects. Delete false current explanatory comments rather than label them historical instructions.
answers.caveats: "no blanket assertWorldIntegrity removal"

answers.answer: VACANCY/CLOCK: receive the actual PR389 state-subject repair; then test continuity, actor/authority replacement, stale scheduled tasks and next election. A vacant office still has a jurisdiction; never invent a dead incumbent to satisfy an event. Fixing the crash does not prove every succession route works.
answers.caveats: "Fixing the crash does not prove every succession route works."

answers.answer: PRESS: extend the already-demonstrated party-story editorial projection to other real events. Shared fact packet; outlet/reader/source-specific coverage; no raw internal summary repeated automatically. Syndication is legitimate when attributed. Multiple articles about one incident do not manufacture independent evidence or duplicate effects.
answers.caveats: "Multiple articles about one incident do not manufacture independent evidence or duplicate effects."

answers.answer: CONSTITUTIONAL/RULE CHANGE: connect proposal to the applicable votes, ratification, effective instrument and future rule readers. A proposal or success sentence is not completed constitutional change. Executive acts require their own actual authority/delegation; they are not bills renamed. Large unsupported transformations remain explicit gaps rather than fake completed outcomes.
answers.caveats: "Large unsupported transformations remain explicit gaps rather than fake completed outcomes."

answers.answer: owner-report-built-but-cannot-happen: order the six as beliefs/propositions, disaster delivery, ballot/recruitment, political aggregation, international origin, rare violence origin, with ordinary-play crashes/entry first. Independently verified NEW CORRECTION: crisis/disaster.ts already adds federalAssisted capacity after federal-declared and records repair progress. Federal aid is therefore not wholly inert. Program labels still do not provide actual money. Connect eligibility/assessment, funding, paid work/capacity and closure without retaining the old bonus PLUS counting the same financed capacity again. Full current-tree caller absence for every other subsystem is still the named audit's evidence, not an independent director run.
answers.caveats: "Program labels still do not provide actual money."; "Full current-tree caller absence for every other subsystem is still the named audit's evidence, not an independent director run."
